chunks.name: molecular-io
chunks.description: Use when reading or writing molecular structures in SMILES, MOL, SDF, or InChI formats, including batch and compressed files: covers smiles, sdf, molfile, inchi; excludes descriptor calculation and fingerprinting
triggers: parse this SMILES string into a molecule
read all molecules from this SDF file
compute the LogP of this molecule should go to rdkit/descriptors
chunks.pointer: Reading and writing molecules (SMILES, MOL, SDF, InChI) and batch suppliers: see `molecular-io/SKILL.md`.

chunks.name: sanitization
chunks.description: Use when molecules fail to parse or need valence, aromaticity, or chirality validation and repair: covers sanitize, valence, aromaticity; excludes descriptor calculation and substructure search
triggers: this molecule fails to sanitize, find the problem
disable sanitization when parsing this SMILES
find the benzene ring in this molecule should go to rdkit/substructure-search
chunks.pointer: Sanitization control, chemistry problem detection, and common sanitization failures: see `sanitization/SKILL.md`.
